routineCycle.title: Routine Cycle
routineCycle.body: Shows routine progress and suggested sessions in your journal and active workout screens.

healthKit.title: Health Data
healthKit.body: Shows heart rate and calories during workouts, and saves completed workouts to Apple Health.
healthKit.deniedBody: Allow health data access to show heart rate and calories. If you already denied it, turn it back on from iOS Settings or the health permissions screen.
healthKit.unavailableBody: Health data connection is available on iPhone devices that support HealthKit.

workoutReminder.title: Workout Reminder
workoutReminder.body: We will remind you once at 22:00 on days when you have not logged a workout.

workoutPlaceReminder.title: Workout Place Alerts
workoutPlaceReminder.body: Suggests starting a workout when you arrive within 20 m of a gym learned from your workouts.
workoutPlaceReminder.backgroundPermissionBody: To detect arrival at your gym when the app is not open, change location access to Always on the next screen.
workoutPlaceReminder.statusPermissionDenied: Location or notification permissions need attention.
workoutPlaceReminder.statusRegistrationFailed: Could not register workout place alerts.
workoutPlaceReminder.statusNoPlace: A place will be learned when a workout result includes a location.
workoutPlaceReminder.listBody: Locations are added automatically from saved workout result locations.
workoutPlaceReminder.listEmpty: No locations yet. A workout result with a saved location will be added automatically.
workoutPlaceReminder.deletePlaceBody: It may be learned again after a future workout at the same place.

calendarAutoAdd.title: Calendar Auto Save
calendarAutoAdd.body: Automatically adds completed workout time to your device calendar.
calendarAutoAdd.permissionDeniedBody: Allow calendar event access to enable auto save. If you already denied it, turn it back on from iOS Settings.

calendar.permissionBody: Allow calendar access in Settings to add workouts to your calendar.
calendar.successBody: Your workout event was added to the calendar.
calendar.addPromptBody: You can save this completed workout as an event in your device calendar.
calendar.autoAddPromptBody: If you agree, completed workout time will be added to your device calendar automatically. You can change this later in Settings.

reminder.title: Workout Reminder
reminder.body: Time to log your next workout.
